description: Roger Marshall. OB-GYN from Great Bend, U.S. Army Reserves veteran (Captain, 1984 to 1991), U.S. Senator (R-KS). Fifth-generation Kansas farm kid born in El Dorado, twenty-five years delivering babies before he ever ran for office. Husband to Laina; dad to Lauren, Victor, Matt, and Cal; grandpa.
